purpose: Licenses approved for components of publicly distributed guest images, the duties each one creates, and the review record (ADR 0020). Approval here never permits a component in the engine, the SDK, the platform SBOM, or Git history.

obligations.license-text: Ship the full license text in the image's licenses/ folder.
obligations.notices: Keep every copyright, license and warranty notice, collected in licenses/NOTICES.txt.
obligations.corresponding-source: Publish the complete corresponding source next to the image in sources/: every module, interface definition, build script, build configuration and patch.
obligations.source-retention: Keep the published source available for as long as the image is offered; ADR 0020 keeps it permanently.
obligations.modification-notices: Mark every file Spacia modifies with a prominent notice of the change.
obligations.no-further-restrictions: Impose no further restriction or charge on the rights the license grants; the terms of service carry the ADR 0020 carve-out.
obligations.relinkable-work: A work that statically links the library permits modification and reverse engineering for debugging such modifications, and is published in a form users can relink.
obligations.no-endorsement: Never use the authors' or contributors' names to endorse or promote.
obligations.mark-altered-versions: Mark altered versions plainly as altered.
obligations.advertising-acknowledgment: Advertising materials that mention the software's features carry the acknowledgment the license prescribes.
